title: Six months with Maya
note: Scripted user messages for a reproducible demo recording; every assistant reply, extracted fact, verification and memory update is produced live by the pipeline.

steps.text: Hi! I just moved to Berlin for a new job as a data analyst at Zalando. Any tips for finding a flat near Friedrichshain?
steps.shows: facts extracted from a request for help

steps.text: My cat Luna hates the cold here. I run 3 times a week to stay sane this winter.
I drive a 2015 Honda Civic but parking in Berlin is a nightmare. Should I keep it?
If I ever win the lottery I'd buy a sailboat and live on it. Anyway, what's a good stretching routine after a run?
steps.shows: hypotheticals are not stored as facts

steps.text: Update: I sold my Civic last weekend, so I'm biking everywhere now.
steps.shows: negation closes a fact; relative date resolved

steps.text: Big news: I quit my data analyst job at Zalando. I'm now a product manager at Spotify!
steps.shows: a job change: the old job is closed and kept as history

steps.text: We moved to Munich two weeks ago because my partner got a job at BMW.
steps.shows: residence supersedes Berlin, dated two weeks earlier

steps.text: Luna loves the new balcony. I now run 5 times a week, I'm training for my first half marathon.
steps.shows: a count updates; a repeated fact is not duplicated
